flags.effect: The version (or image digest) to move one server to (default: the newest one the last check found)
flags.name: --to

flags.effect: Every server that has an update, in one plan
flags.name: --all

flags.effect: Ask the registry or GitHub first, so the plan sees what was published since the last check and that the version exists
flags.name: --fetch

flags.effect: Show the exact change to the registry entry, the release file and whether a call is running, and change nothing
flags.name: --dry-run

flags.effect: The hash of the reviewed plan; the update stops when the plan has changed
flags.name: --plan-hash

flags.effect: Install a release file the publisher gives no checksum for
flags.name: --allow-unverified

flags.effect: Restart even when a call is running; the call ends
flags.name: --restart-now

flags.effect: Seconds to wait for the gateways' answers to the restart
flags.name: --wait

flags.effect: Put back what the last update changed, when nothing has changed it since
flags.name: --undo

summary: Move servers to another version of their pinned package or GitHub release: the plan shows the exact change, then the pin is rewritten and the server restarts <server>... or --all [--to <version>] [--fetch] [--dry-run] [--plan-hash] [--allow-unverified] [--restart-now|--no-restart], or --undo
